import torch, time
from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
for name in ['protectai/deberta-v3-base-prompt-injection-v2','meta-llama/Llama-Prompt-Guard-2-86M']:
    try:
        t0=time.time()
        tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(name, local_files_only=True)
        model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(name, local_files_only=True)
        model.eval()
        inp = tok(['the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog','another example sentence about networking'], padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=128, return_tensors='pt')
        with torch.no_grad():
            out = model(**inp)
        h = out.last_hidden_state
        mask = inp['attention_mask'].unsqueeze(-1).float()
        pooled = (h*mask).sum(1)/mask.sum(1)
        pooled = torch.nn.functional.normalize(pooled, p=2, dim=1)
        print(name, '| dim=', h.shape[-1], '| load %.1fs'%(time.time()-t0), '| cos_sim=%.4f' % torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(pooled[0],pooled[1]).item())
        del model, tok
        torch.cuda.empty_cache() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None
    except Exception as e:
        print(name, 'FAILED:', type(e).__name__, str(e)[:150])
" 2>&1 | grep -v Warning
